title: Identity session core
description: Objective: implement principal, session, credential, capability, and command-authentication models. Deliverable: packages/core identity modules with hostile spoof, expiry, replay, and scope tests. NOT in scope: transport authentication, leases, presence, provider credentials, or multi-user RBAC. Hard dependency: Runtime contract registry. Owned paths: packages/core/src/identity/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Missing, expired, spoofed, wrong-scope, and replayed credentials have zero business effect.
Capabilities are exact, immutable, least-authority records with stable rejection codes.
Authentication facts never upgrade agent-reported evidence or presence.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
